findings.finding: Key: From sum equality after transfer, B_a+B_s=10, A_a+A_s=20. Enumerate B_a∈[1,10], A_s∈[5,19] with A_a=20-A_s, B_s=10-B_a. Impose A_a·A_s=4·B_a·B_s and A_a·(A_s-5)=B_a·(B_s+5). Unique solution (A_a,A_s,B_a,B_s)=(10,10,5,5). Product ages=10·5=50.

Set sums: a+A=2(b+B) and a+A=b+B+10 ⇒ a+A=20, b+B=10. Let A=20−a, B=10−b (A≥5 ⇒ a≤15). Equations become a(20−a)=4b(10−b) and a(15−a)=b(15−b). From second, b=a or b=15−a. Test integers 1≤a≤15,1≤b≤10; only (a,b)=(10,5) works. Product of ages =10·5=50.
